name: Heisthof
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to Heisthof in Tirol** Discover the authentic charm of the **Heisthof** in the heart of **Tirol**, where tradition meets modern comfort. Nestled in the breathtaking **Inntal**, this historic farmhouse invites you to experience the warmth of Tyrolean hospitality. Indulge in regional specialties like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, creamy **Käsekrainer**, and crisp **Speckknödel**, all crafted with local ingredients. The cozy atmosphere, paired with panoramic views of the **Alpen**, makes every meal unforgettable. Whether you’re seeking relaxation in the rustic **Stüberl** or adventure in the surrounding **Zillertal** or **Karwendel**, the **Heisthof** is your perfect retreat. Come and taste the soul of **Tirol**—where every moment feels like home. --- **Plan your stay** | **Contact us**
